title: Practice notices ride the notification router

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-10-26 (audits/meta-scan-2026-10-26.md), Phase 4 follow-up: remaining direct bell inserts

detail: The practice-complete notice, the daily practice reminder and the once-ever staleness prompt read the member's practice switches by hand and inserted the bell row and sent the push themselves. They now route the registry rows practice.term_complete and practice.reminder (in-app and push) and practice.stale_check (in-app), so the member's own inapp_practice and push_practice switches, suppression and the outbox retry apply through the one seam. The bell rows are unchanged (same type, practice reference, body); push copy, url and tag are unchanged. The wired-switch detector's positive control in lib/notifications/wired.test.ts now expects the practice readers to be registry rows rather than lifecycle.ts, with the owner's go-ahead (Daniel, 'update the practice reader pin', 2026-10-26).

verify.note: Exits 0 once lifecycle.ts routes its notices and no longer inserts bell rows itself.
